summary.zh-TW: 設定頁最常見的開關：點擊時滑塊滑到另一邊，途中被拉長再縮回，按住時滑塊先稍微變寬。顏色交給 CSS，位置和形變交給 GSAP。
summary.en: The most common control on a settings page: on click the thumb slides across, stretching on the way and settling back; pressing widens it slightly first. CSS handles colour, GSAP handles position and shape.

text.zh-TW: 滑塊只用 x（transform）移動，不改 left 或 margin，動畫才會順。移動距離用量的：軌道內寬 − 滑塊寬，改 CSS 尺寸也不用改程式。
text.en: The thumb moves with x (a transform), not left or margin, so it stays smooth. The distance is measured — track inner width minus thumb width — so changing the CSS size needs no code change.

text.zh-TW: 連續快速點擊時，先停掉上一段還沒跑完的動畫，從目前的位置接著走，不會卡住或跳回起點。
text.en: When clicked rapidly, it stops the unfinished animation and continues from the current position instead of stuttering or jumping back.

text.zh-TW: 移動途中把滑塊拉長 1.4 倍再縮回，從「出發的那一側」拉長（transformOrigin），看起來像往前衝。改成 1 就是單純的滑動。
text.en: Stretches the thumb 1.4× mid-move and settles back, anchored on the side it leaves from (transformOrigin), so it seems to lunge forward. Set it to 1 for a plain slide.

text.zh-TW: 軌道顏色用 CSS 過渡，不用 GSAP：GSAP 會把顏色寫死在 style 上，切換亮暗模式時就不會跟著變。
text.en: Track colour uses a CSS transition rather than GSAP: GSAP would bake the colour into the style attribute, so it wouldn’t follow light/dark changes.

text.zh-TW: 用 button 加上 role="switch"，鍵盤的 Enter、空白鍵都能切換，讀屏軟體會唸出「開關，開啟」。
text.en: A button with role="switch" toggles with Enter or Space, and screen readers announce “switch, on”.
